title: deviation
description: One thing the specification does not settle, found while building. Written by a role to .c4s-impl/deviations/<id>.json; shipped by the orchestrator at the end of the iteration with `c4s create-patch`, whose patch kinds it uses.

kind.description: missing: the specification is silent; incorrect: two places disagree, or one is wrong about what exists; clarification: ambiguous, or not buildable as written; drift: delta window only, the code already does something else

blocking.description: true when any assumption would change a contract another unit relies on; false when an ASSUMPTION marker is safe

address.description: <unit>/<layer> or <unit>/<section anchor>: the place in the specification the deviation is about

text.description: what was found, and what the implementer assumed (non-blocking) or needs (blocking)

assumption.description: the ASSUMPTION:<id> marker text placed in code, for a non-blocking deviation
